vision: Our vision is to raise a people who are empowered by the Word of God and equipped to make a positive impact in the world. Winners Chapel International Milwaukee Wisconsin is a place where believers can grow in faith, discover their purpose, and experience God's power in every area of their lives.
mission: Our mission is to preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ, offering spiritual nourishment, guidance, and support to help individuals experience true freedom and fulfilment in Christ. We are committed to building a church that is grounded in faith, love, and compassion.
history: Winners Chapel International Milwaukee Wisconsin is the branch of the Living Faith Church Worldwide where Dr. David Oyedepo is the Presiding Bishop. The church was inaugurated in 2010 and has continued to grow in its city and community.

pillars.title: FAITH
pillars.quote: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

pillars.title: THE WORD
pillars.quote: Who being the brightness of his glory, and upholding all things by the word of his power.

pillars.title: THE SUPERNATURAL
pillars.quote: The wind bloweth where it listeth... so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

pillars.title: THE HOLY SPIRIT
pillars.quote: And the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

pillars.title: PROSPERITY
pillars.quote: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health.

pillars.title: PRAYER
pillars.quote: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he heareth us.

pillars.title: HEALING
pillars.quote: Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.

pillars.title: WISDOM
pillars.quote: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times.

pillars.title: SUCCESS
pillars.quote: For then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

pillars.title: VISION
pillars.quote: Where there is no vision, the people perish.

pillars.title: CONSECRATION
pillars.quote: Let everyone that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

pillars.title: PRAISE
pillars.quote: And when they began to sing and to praise, the Lord set ambushments.
